Hi Sahil —

Huge thanks again for partnering with us on the two-week POC. Quick, high-level recap from our side (numbers pulled from the shared dashboard you gave access to):

- End-to-end inference latency (p95) dropped from 320ms to 184ms (~42% improvement) for your top SKU search flow.
- Cost per average inference (token-normalized) improved by ~3.1x after enabling workload-aware batching + prefix caching.
- Peak throughput sustained increased ~4x on the same instance footprint during promo spikes.
- Error rate (inference timeouts/retries) halved, saving ~12% of failed invocations.

Those wins map pretty directly to your goals (faster search response + lower infra ops spend). We're putting together a short one-pager and a 30–60s highlight clip for marketing. Two asks:

1) Would you be comfortable sharing a 1–2 sentence quote we can use (attribution: name + title + Tiller Labs)? Something like a one-liner about observed performance/cost impact.
2) Can we book a quick 10–15 minute call (recording optional) to confirm the quote and permissions to use Tiller logo? No heavy prep — just confirm the numbers and sign-off.

Proposed slots (PT): Wed 11/04 10:00–10:15, Wed 11/04 15:00–15:15, Thu 11/05 09:00–09:15. If none work, toss over times that do.

I’ll CC Marcus Lin from Growth to keep him in the loop.

Thanks — excited to share this with the broader community.

Best,
Olga
